note: Vocabulary for @annotations. Data, not code: a new annotation kind is an edit here, and an unknown name is reported by annotations.check instead of being ignored.

mechanism.description: What bet the composite is supposed to express, in words. Free text, used for grouping and review.

leg.description: Names an assignment and its job in the composite: carrier, stabiliser, normaliser.

ablate.description: Requests an ablation of this leg. When present, derive_ablations uses these instead of every leg.

expect.description: Declares what a field is meant to represent. Checked against the catalogue so a renamed or wrong field is caught before it costs a simulation.

intent.description: The normalised form this expression is trying to reach, e.g. 'rank(fundamental / size)'. Used by the rewrite layer to decide what is already applied.
